ei.title: The Importance of Showing You Care
ei.subject: 올림포스전국연합고1_2026

fullPassage: When it comes to helping out, you don't have to do much. All you have to do is come around and show that you care. If you notice someone who is lonely, you could go and sit with them. If you work with someone who eats lunch all by themselves, and you go and sit down with them, they will begin to be more social after a while, and they will owe it all to you. A person's happiness comes from attention. There are too many people out in the world who feel like everyone has forgotten them or ignored them. Even if you say hi to someone passing by, they will begin to feel better about themselves, like someone cares.

A person's happiness comes from attention. There are too many people out in the world who feel like everyone has forgotten them or ignored them. Even if you say hi to someone passing by, they will begin to feel better about themselves, like someone cares.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ whom is lonely → who is lonely: 주격 관계대명사 who
det.analysis:
✅ ① helping out: 'When it comes to helping out'에서 전치사 to + 동명사 — 적절

✅ ② do is come: 'All you have to do is come around'에서 주격보어로 쓰인 원형부정사 — 적절

❌ ③ whom is lonely → who is lonely: 'someone who is lonely'에서 관계사가 뒤 동사 is의 주어 역할을 하므로 주격 관계대명사 who가 적절. 목적격 whom은 오류 ← 정답

✅ ④ all by themselves: 'eats lunch all by themselves'에서 재귀대명사 — 적절
det.tip: someone who is lonely = 외로운 사람 (who=주격 관계대명사)

det.analysis:

❌ ② do is coming around → do is come around: 'All you have to do is come around'에서 'All ... do is' 뒤에는 원형부정사(또는 to부정사)가 보어로 오므로 come이 적절. 동명사 coming은 오류 ← 정답

✅ ③ notice: 'If you notice someone'에서 조건절 동사 — 적절

✅ ④ all by themselves: 'eats lunch all by themselves'에서 재귀대명사 — 적절
det.tip: All (that) you have to do is + 원형부정사 (do is come)
